negatives.statement: The first post-push live-remote equality wrapper indexed the first character of the live hash instead of splitting the remote line into fields, so it reported a false mismatch after local, upstream, and tracking equality and 0/0 divergence had already passed.
negatives.recovery: Kept the immutable x1 commit unchanged, parsed the live remote line into fields in a read-only rerun, and proved clean local, upstream, tracking, and live-remote equality at the exact x1 commit.

negatives.statement: The first full candidate validator passed 370 checks but failed the inherited frozen-index hash check because it compared LF-normalized bytes with the raw-byte digest preregistered in the immutable x1 packet.
negatives.recovery: Retained the mismatch, left the x1 packet unchanged, made the validator honor the frozen index's raw-byte digest while preserving LF-normalized manifest hashing, regenerated the negative register, and reran the complete validation.

negatives.statement: A recursive lookup for prior receipt builders exceeded the command timeout while traversing the inherited script corpus and returned no usable result.
negatives.recovery: Retained the timeout, stopped the broad lookup, and used the already verified phase-local validators plus bounded owner-scoped receipt generation.

negatives.statement: A complete-suite invocation discovered tests by absolute path while the process remained outside the repository root, so six modules failed import-only loading of the scripts package and the run stopped after 206 tests.
negatives.recovery: Retained the runner-context failure and reran the identical discovery pattern from the repository root so package imports resolved without changing code or host configuration.

negatives.statement: The first evidence-snapshot A wrapper used PowerShell stop-on-error semantics, which promoted unittest's normal stderr summary before the native exit code could be inspected and ended the wrapper without a complete receipt.
negatives.recovery: Retained the wrapper failure, verified the detached worktree remained clean at the exact evidence commit, and reran with explicit native-process exit-code handling before accepting any result.

boundary: Append every recovered transition or x2 operational failure; never erase it after a later pass.
